description: Fixes recipe viewers (EMI) not detecting fluids (gases) in item capabilities and machine tanks

mods.name: EMI Capability Bridge
mods.description: Fixes recipe viewers not detecting fluids in item capabilities and machine tanks

releases.notes:
## 1.0.1
- Fixed fluid highlight incorrectly triggering in player inventory (should only apply to chests/storage).
- Fixed PhantomFluidWidget being falsely detected as a real fluid tank, causing false-positive fluid availability.
- Fixed fluid auto-fill only transferring a single recipe batch worth instead of the full requested amount.
- Fixed item ingredients not being auto-filled at all when a recipe also required a fluid ingredient.
- Rewrite logging to avoid log spam while still surfacing real errors.
